description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the ProductRelationshipDao interface, providing methods to query product relationships from the database using JPA/Hibernate. It extends a generic DAO and includes multiple methods for retrieving product relationships based on various filters like type, group, product, and store.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access methods for ProductRelationship entities, enabling retrieval based on type, group, product, and store, utilizing JPA queries.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects filtered by store, type, product, and language.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects filtered by store, type, and language.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects filtered by store and group.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of group relationships that are not linked to any specific product.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects filtered only by store and type.

methods.name: listByProducts
